required_evidence: failure, concurrency, teardown, and restoration results

required_module_properties: native Rust module entry and exit
standalone Rust implementation of project-owned behavior

evidence_invalidation_rules.invalidates: FP-0001, FP-0002, FP-0006 and every downstream WS10-WS80 PASS gate

evidence_invalidation_rules.change: frozen reference commit, IHK commit, module artifact, or inventory digest
evidence_invalidation_rules.invalidates: FP-0003 through FP-0006 plus all differential, compatibility, benchmark, and release evidence

evidence_invalidation_rules.change: Rocky release, kernel source, kernel config, NVR, toolchain, or signing identity
evidence_invalidation_rules.invalidates: affected RK, RS, module-build, integration, benchmark, and release PASS gates
evidence_invalidation_rules.reason: the exact kernel ABI or trusted artifact set changed

evidence_invalidation_rules.change: module source, unsafe ledger, assembly allowlist, dependency graph, UAPI, IKC, or link graph
evidence_invalidation_rules.invalidates: the affected module gate and all dependent integration, qualification, and release PASS gates
evidence_invalidation_rules.reason: implementation, safety, ABI, or executable provenance changed

evidence_invalidation_rules.change: acceptance test definition, workload, threshold, seed policy, harness, or hardware-class definition
evidence_invalidation_rules.invalidates: the affected validation or benchmark PASS gate and every release gate consuming it
evidence_invalidation_rules.reason: the meaning of the evidence changed

evidence_invalidation_rules.change: evidence becomes unavailable, unverifiable, corrupt, expired, or loses exact artifact provenance
evidence_invalidation_rules.invalidates: the PASS gate naming that evidence
evidence_invalidation_rules.reason: PASS credit requires durable independently checkable evidence

forbidden_production_inputs: project-authored C or C++ archive member
runtime dispatch into a reference C implementation

permitted_non_rust_boundaries.boundary: Linux kernel core and kernel-provided symbols
permitted_non_rust_boundaries.conditions: called through reviewed Rust abstractions or a narrowly audited Rust FFI declaration
declarations and generated bindings only; no project implementation body

permitted_non_rust_boundaries.boundary: generated Kbuild metadata, module metadata, linker scripts, and kernel headers
permitted_non_rust_boundaries.conditions: generated or declarative build boundary only
Rust asm or global_asm preferred; standalone assembly separately hashed, reviewed, justified, and allowlisted
